turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: Evergreen Pest & Lawn · Renewal prep · 2026-10-09

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: **Attendees:** [PERSON_1] (Owner), [PERSON_2] (Marketing Manager), [PERSON_3] (CSM)

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: Summary

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: Early renewal-prep call with [PERSON_1] and [PERSON_2] ahead of the 2027-05-01 renewal. Fall is their slow season, so we spent most of the time on lead volume and where the account stands before the renewal conversation gets formal. [PERSON_1] flagged cost pressure and [PERSON_2] raised a conversion timing item we need to look into.

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: Discussion

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: Fall slowdown is normal for them. Call volume down from summer peak, roughly in line with last October.

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: Six locations, all running tracking numbers, no new locations planned for now.

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: [PERSON_2] runs the whole marketing motion herself, no plans to add headcount this year.

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: Google Ads is the main paid channel; budget steady, no changes planned for Q4.

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: [PERSON_1] mentioned he gets regular outreach from other vendors. Said it's mostly noise but he does read it.

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: Renewal is still months out. [PERSON_1] wants a clear picture of what they're getting before he signs anything.

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: No complaints on the account side, day-to-day is running fine.

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: Product feedback

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: [PERSON_1] said the renewal number is hard to justify for six locations, and asked whether there is a smaller package without Signal AI.

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: [PERSON_2] has a CallTrackingMetrics quote for roughly half our price and said she would at least have to show it to [PERSON_1].

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: [PERSON_2] also noticed Google Ads conversions for booked calls showing up a day or two late over the last few weeks.

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: Risks

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: Price sensitivity plus an active competitor quote could stall the renewal if we don't get ahead of it.

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: The conversion timing item, if it drags, gives [PERSON_1] another reason to question the spend.

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: Next steps

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: [PERSON_3] to pull usage and value summary for the account before next call, by 2026-10-16.

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: [PERSON_3] to bring the conversion timing item to the product team and report back, by 2026-10-16.

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: [PERSON_2] to send the CallTrackingMetrics quote details over to [PERSON_3], by 2026-10-13.

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: [PERSON_3] to set a follow-up call with [PERSON_1] and [PERSON_2], target week of 2026-10-19.
